verdict.rationale: Attio's docs confirm custom fields ('Customize fields to capture exactly what you need to track'), filtering/sorting capabilities, and object/list data modeling that ops users could use to build views without engineering, but evidence is API/docs-centric rather than showing the actual no-admin UI workflow for creating and sharing saved views. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the UI-level 'shared views' feature and permission model confirming non-admin ops users can create/share views without admin involvement.
